build_sampler_for_algorithm: build a sampler for a CLRS algorithm like quicksort or dijkstra using build_sampler with the algorithm name and number of samples
sample_batch_with_next: sample a batch of training data by calling next on a sampler instance with a specified batch size
create_custom_sampler_class: create a custom sampler class by subclassing Sampler and implementing the abstract _sample_data method
generate_random_graph: generate a random Erdos-Renyi graph using _random_er_graph with configurable nodes, edge probability, and directed or weighted options
process_permutations_in_samples: process permutation data in sample iterators using process_permutations to convert should-be-permutations into proper permutation pointers and masks
